relevance points

Score = 0.8 × weighted requirement coverage + 0.2 × weighted first-evidence prominence. Prominence per match = 1 − nonblank-line rank / max(1, nonblank-line count − 1). Missing requirements receive zero. JD lines containing required/must/essential have weight 2; others weight 1. The same aliases, weights, and requirements are frozen before tailoring.

This is a lexical diagnostic, not an ATS score or hiring probability. Qualifications do not improve just because evidence moves earlier. Years, seniority and degree requirements are not scored.
